testCorrection.description: The endpoint taper check now compares signed outward relief with half the positive central relief. Buried endpoints retain the original skin-fit bounds, while shoulder, topology, normal and seam checks are unchanged.

coverage: closed connected outward eyelid topology
finite unit normals and smooth welded seams
mirrored upper and lower eye contours
shallow relief and tapered corners measured against skull triangles
visible fitted closed eye seams
head tilt and unchanged local eyelid shapes
opaque skin lids and distinct dark app contrast seams
retained lip, body, recovery and hook behavior
actual rendered scene and perspective camera
all face feature vertices including all four lids remain framed
per-lid local geometry fingerprints and head-relative attachment
actual eyelid world movement after the recovery turn
native keyboard view controls
learner state retention
text spacing
forced colors
app contrast
axe accessibility and runtime checks
one live app-created WebGL context
context cleanup after unmount
